SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT KALABURAGI IN MVC NO.1204/2019 AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO ENHANCE THE COMPENSATION, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL ORDER Heard the arguments of both sides.
2.

This appeal is filed against the judgment and award of the Tribunal in MVC No.1204/2019 dated 07.01.2022 passed by the I Additional Senior Civil Judge and M.A.C.T, Kalaburagi (for short 'the Tribunal').
3. Injured/claimant filed a claim petition claiming compensation Rs.33,50,000 with interest.
The Tribunal considering entire evidence on record, granted an amount of NC: 2025:KHC-K:7103 HC-KAR Rs.5,41,200/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from date of petition till realization.
4. Aggrieved by the said order, this appeal is preferred in which it is contented that, the appellant was hospitalized as an inpatient from 03.05.2019 to 11.05.2019.
Appellant examined PW2 - Doctor and he assessed the disability as 51%, but the Tribunal has erroneously taken a lesser percentage.
Further, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is inadequate and the amounts granted under other heads are meager.
Therefore, requested for enhancement.

Channappa vs Ashok And Anr on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167436418/
2 5.
The appellant was aged 37 years doing agriculture and earning 6,00,000 per annum, but he has not filed any income proof.
As he met with an accident on 03.05.2019, as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, his notional income is to be taken as Rs.13,250/- per month.
Appellant examined the doctor as PW2 as stated above and he issued a disability certificate marked at Ex.P7 and assessed the disability as 51%.
It is NC: 2025:KHC-K:7103 HC-KAR observed that there is shortening of lower 3rd leg and he was unable to walk without support and there is malunion fracture of lower end of the tibia and fibula.

The Tribunal has taken the disability as 42%
and 1/3rd of the same comes to 14% to the whole body.
But, this Court finds it reasonable to modify the same as 1/3rd of 51% i.e., 17% and the appropriate multiplier for 37 years be '15'.

Accordingly,
the loss of future income comes to Rs.13,250 x 12 x 15 x 17% = 4,05,450.
6.
He was hospitalized for 9 days.
The Tribunal granted Rs.1,61,329/- towards medical expenses, as per Ex.P6 and it needs no interference.

7. Considering the nature of injury, period of hospitalization and occupation of the appellant, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.50,000/- for pain and suffering, Rs.25,000/- for loss of amenities and Rs.30,000/- for transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7103 HC-KAR 8.

He might not have done any other work at least for a period of three months, therefore,
Rs.39,750/- (13,250 x 3) is awarded under head loss of income during laid up period.
9. In all, the total compensation comes to Rs.7,11,529/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization.

10. The award of the Tribunal is modified as under:
 Heads Amount in Rs.
1. Loss of income 4,05,450/-
2. Pain and suffering 50,000/-
3. Loss of amenities 25,000/-
4.

Medical expenses 1,61,329/-
5. Transportation, extra nourishment 30,000/-
and attendant charges 6.

Loss of earning during the laid up 39,750/-
period for 6 months  Total 7,11,529/-
Accordingly, the appellant is entitled for a total compensation of Rs.7,11,529/- as against Rs.5,41,200/-.
The claimant is entitled for an enhanced compensation of Rs.1,70,329/-.

3 11.

In the result, the following order is passed:
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7103 HC-KAR i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) Respondent No.2 - Insurance company already deposited the awarded amount before the tribunal, therefore, respondent No.2 is directed to deposit the enhanced compensation of Rs.1,70,329/- with interest at the rate of 6% within 1 month from the date of this order.
iii) On such deposit, the appellant is permitted to withdraw the entire amount along with the interest accrued on it.
